name: Remote IT Support Engineer
desc: 100% virtual IT support for your team. Whenever software breaks, freezes, or cloud accounts need management, they fix it remotely quickly so your staff can keep moving. (No on-site hardware setup).

name: Cloud Network Engineer
desc: Keeps your cloud infrastructure and remote networks connected reliably. Designs, stabilizes, and secures your virtual networks and VPNs without needing an on-site presence.

name: Security Engineer L2
desc: Protects your business from unauthorized access, data loss, and security failures. Monitors your systems remotely to keep customer payments and private records secure.

name: Tech Lead
desc: Provides senior technical oversight for digital projects. When you are building new features, automations, or platforms, this role helps ensure the work is designed correctly from the start.

name: Mid-Level Developer
desc: Builds the features, automations, and integrations your business runs on. This role turns approved ideas into working software that supports daily operations.

name: Junior Developer
desc: Handles routine development tasks such as updates, fixes, configuration changes, and testing. This role keeps smaller execution work moving without slowing larger projects down.

name: Project Manager
desc: Coordinates people, timelines, and deliverables so projects keep moving. This role reduces delays, follows up on blockers, and keeps execution aligned across distributed teams.

name: SEO Specialist
desc: Improves your visibility in search so customers can find your business without relying only on paid ads. This role focuses on rankings, technical SEO, and search-driven traffic quality.

name: QA Engineer
desc: Tests digital experiences before they reach customers or staff. The goal is to catch issues early so broken workflows do not go live.

name: DevOps Engineer
desc: Maintains the cloud infrastructure that keeps your systems available and stable. This role helps reduce downtime, supports deployments, and improves reliability as usage grows.

name: Digital Marketing Manager
desc: Owns the direction behind your marketing efforts, including priorities, channels, budget, and performance. This role helps keep marketing tied to business growth instead of activity alone.

name: Performance Marketing Specialist
desc: Manages paid advertising across platforms with a focus on measurable return. This role helps track lead cost, improve targeting, and reduce wasted spend over time.

name: Content Writer
desc: Writes the customer-facing copy your business depends on, including website pages, emails, messages, ads, captions, and scripts. This role helps keep communication clear, consistent, and action-oriented.

name: Graphic Designer
desc: Creates the visual assets your business uses across digital and print channels. This role helps keep the brand consistent, polished, and ready for customer-facing use.

name: Social Media Executive
desc: Keeps your social channels active and organized through posting, scheduling, and response management. This role helps maintain consistency even when internal bandwidth is limited.

name: General Virtual Assistant
desc: General administrative support: inbox, scheduling, data, and routine day-to-day tasks.

name: Executive Assistant
desc: High-level support for owners and executives: calendar, communications, and coordination.

name: Data Entry Specialist
desc: Accurate, high-volume data entry and record-keeping.

name: Customer Service VA
desc: Handles customer questions, tickets, and follow-up across email, chat, and phone.

name: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
desc: Outbound prospecting, qualifying leads, and booking meetings.

name: Lead Generation Specialist
desc: Builds targeted prospect lists and sources new leads.

name: Bookkeeping VA
desc: Day-to-day bookkeeping: transactions, reconciliation, and basic reports.
